phase_name: Cockpit Visual Polish (Design Spec Locked → Implementation Deferred to v3.4)
goal: P135 was scoped as a client.js polish phase to match the brief HTML quality bar. After operator feedback on the minimal live cockpit output, the scope shifted: operator engaged Claude Design to produce a full IA-rewrite design pack. P135 closes with the design package as the deliverable; implementation is rescoped to milestone v3.4 (8 phases P136-P143).

decisions.decision: Implementation deferred to v3.4. P135 closes with design pack as the deliverable; v3.4 phases P136-P143 implement.

Operator concern: parts of SGSD must not silently go stale or lose connection. v3.4 baked-in: Cockpit Source Registry · per-source heartbeat · staleness pills · liveness conformance gate · SSE keep-alive + reconnect.

deferred_items: v3.4 P136 — design tokens + IA scaffold
v3.4 P137 — snapshot data contract expansion + source registry + liveness heartbeat
v3.4 P138 — sticky chrome + SSE keep-alive + reconnect badge
v3.4 P140 — §3 Architecture + §4 Milestone SVG diagrams
v3.4 P142 — §7 Event tape + alarm drawer + rationale drawer + 5-second test conformance
v3.4 P143 — conformance promotion + liveness coverage SAC

constraints: Light command-room palette only (no dark theme in v3.4; dark variant deferred to v3.5+)
IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Mono + Big Shoulders Display 900 (no other type families)
Orthogonal connectors only in diagrams (HVH default, viaX/viaY for forks)
Memory typing: observation (solid) / claim (outlined/validated/refuted) / decision (yellow stripe + terminal feel)
Liveness contract: every cockpit source enumerated in cockpit-sources.yaml; per-source freshness tier visible per section; no silent staleness
extension_points: v3.5+ may add dark variant; tweaks-panel.jsx provides a design-tuning UI pattern that could ship as an operator preference layer
